# IntelliJ Platform Icons

Copyright JetBrains s.r.o. and contributors.

The following unmodified SVG assets were retrieved from the JetBrains IntelliJ
Community repository on October 28, 2026. They are distributed under the Apache
License, Version 2.0; see the accompanying `LICENSE.txt`.

Upstream base: https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community/tree/master/platform/icons/src

- `ic_memory_field.svg`: `nodes/field.svg`
- `ic_memory_class.svg`: `nodes/class.svg`
- `ic_memory_object.svg`: `nodes/interface.svg`
- `ic_memory_array.svg`: `debugger/db_array.svg`
- `ic_memory_primitive.svg`: `debugger/db_primitive.svg`

The profiler uses these as field, class, instance, array, and primitive type
indicators. No IntelliJ runtime dependency or Android Studio binary is bundled.
